title: json-fn checker conformance test suite
description: Documents the checker test-suite format consumed from spec/cases/check.

$schema.description: Identifies the checker-case schema relative to the suite file. Loaders verify the value matches the suite's actual directory depth below spec/cases/check.

description.description: A description of the test suite.

builtins.description: The default builtin callable selection for cases in this suite.

options.description: The default portable checker options for cases in this suite.

cases.description: The checker cases in this suite.

builtins.description: standard loads the portable registry from spec/builtins/builtins.json; none provides no builtin callable table.

allowUntypedFunctions.description: Permit module-level functions without declared signatures, recording visible coverage degradation instead of an error.

description.description: A description used as the test name.

builtins.description: Overrides the suite builtin selection for this case.

options.description: Overrides the suite checker options for this case.

expression.description: A canonical json-fn expression to check, including an explicit null.

defs.description: Named schema definitions in scope while checking an expression. Allowed only on expression cases.

module.description: A canonical json-fn module to check.

contract.description: A portable environment contract linked while checking a module. Allowed only on module cases; deep contract validation is enforced by the loader.

expected.description: The complete expected outcome of an ordinary checker run.

type.description: The exact inferred schema, compared by canonical JSON equality. Allowed only for expression cases.

diagnostics.description: The complete expected diagnostic multiset, matched unordered.

diagnostic.description: A matcher that must consume exactly one actual diagnostic.

path.description: The exact canonical JSON path of the diagnostic as string segments.

severity.description: error is a definite type failure; info records visible loss of type coverage.

messageIncludes.description: A substring that must occur in the diagnostic message.

expected.description: The exact expected schema attached to the diagnostic.

actual.description: The exact actual schema attached to the diagnostic.

throws.description: Requires checking to fail outside recover-and-continue diagnostics, such as the fixed structural-depth limit.

messageIncludes.description: A substring that must occur in the thrown error message.
